title: 第14章 真实的冷兵器战斗
content_zh:
第14章真实的冷兵器战斗
“练武场功能，你可以慢慢摸索。”一旁青衫男子道，“接下来，我要告诉你，整个游戏世界的战斗空间。”
许景明点头。
生命进化世界，主要分成个人空间、任务空间、战斗空间三大块。
“哗。”
青衫男子一挥手。
面前出现了画面，有五道身影在选择兵器铠甲。
“战斗空间，是五人选择兵器铠甲……之后进入地图内，和敌方五人进行生死搏杀，杀到一方全部死去，另一方便为获胜。”
青衫男子说着又一挥手，画面变成了一座古代小镇。
小镇，细雨绵绵。
一共十人，分散在小镇各处。
“咻。”
有一根箭矢在雨水中破空，射向了敌人，那躲在屋顶的敌人察觉到不对劲，转头看时，箭矢之快，敌人反应都来不及，噗！一箭射穿了敌人的头部，射穿的刹那，敌人化作虚影消散开去，退出了这个地图。
“杀！”有彪悍男子，飞奔而出，直奔那放暗箭的弓箭手，同时甩出手中短矛。
一根又一根短矛，接连甩出！他背后可是带着足足两背囊的短矛。
弓箭手吓得一边逃跑，一边回射弓箭，显然惊慌下的射移动目标，一点都不准，都没碰到对方。
“噗。”逃到中途，就被一根短矛贯穿胸膛，身上的皮甲都被贯穿，弓箭手也化作虚影消散。
“一个个只会远攻，真是无趣。”一名身高两米一的高大壮汉，全身厚重甲铠，仅有头部露出，坐在小镇中央，拎着酒坛喝着酒，声音响彻小镇，“有胆子的，来和爷爷我正面一对一。”
“你这头熊憨憨，我来会你一会。”一名穿着红色轻甲的女剑客大步走出。
眼前的冷兵器战斗场景，箭矢、短矛、大斧、长枪、利剑……让许景明看得血脉偾张，他前面二十年追求的武道兵器格斗，最危险的战斗模式的就是眼前的场景啊！

“现实中的武道兵器格斗，有各种安全措施，哪有这般打得尽兴？”许景明看得兴奋，这才是最适合自己的舞台。
“战斗空间，就是让五名队友，和另外五名对手，进行冷兵器厮杀。”青衫男子说道，“你可以选择厚重铠甲，但身法就会大大受影响。选择轻便的软甲，防御就弱了。各有取舍。”
“远攻、近战、埋伏……”青衫男子笑道，“因为游戏刚开始，战斗水平都比较弱，眼前这一战是刚刚直播的一场算不错的战斗了，但依旧有很多问题，五个人战五个人，更重要是团队配合。”
“当然你如果够强，一人灭了五人，那是你牛。”青衫男子笑道，“不过高水平的战斗，都是整个蓝星最顶尖的一群高手，冷兵器战斗技巧、战斗的谋略、队友配合，都非常重要。”
许景明点头：“五人对五人？没有一对一？”
“暂时没有。”
青衫男子道，“这款虚拟游戏，设定的核心游戏模式，就是五人组队，冷兵器搏杀。”
许景明了然，眼中却是火热。
每一个职业武道选手，最梦寐以求的，不就是这种冷兵器搏杀场景吗？而且最妙的是，游戏中搏杀，死了也只是一局游戏失败而已。
“每个玩家，按照实力不同，也分级别。”青衫男子道，“最弱的是繁星级，高一步的是银月级，再高的就是曜日级！最高的是神级。”
“繁星级玩家，是新手玩家。”
“银月级玩家，基础战力门槛是150。”
“曜日级玩家，基础战力门槛是400。”
“神级玩家，基础战力门槛是1000。”
“想要提升级别，有两种方法。一种是前一级达到满星，并且达到基础战力门槛，即可升级。另一种是达到基础战力门槛的120%，可直接参加定级赛，通过定级赛……就可直接达到新级别。”
“比如一个新手玩家，基础战力480，第一次战斗，就可以参加曜日级定级赛，一旦通过，直接就是曜日级玩家。无需从繁星级一步步升上来。”青衫男子解释道。
许景明微微点头，看了下个人战力面板。
玩家：许景明
基因进化法：《天蟒进化法》（初阶5%）（练习时间982天，不可提升）
技能：枪法（二阶71%），步法（二阶11%）

基础战力：
“我的枪法和步法？”许景明有些惊讶。
“你之前，在练武场中练枪法时，虚拟游戏就自动鉴定你的枪法、步法层次。”青衫男子解释道。
“基础战力756，是怎么算的？”许景明问道。
“身体越强，身体指数就越高。技能，就是各种战斗技巧。强大的身体，配合厉害的战斗技巧，便决定了基础战力。”青衫男子解释道。
许景明微微点头，看向了面板上的枪法，枪法是自己最自信的：“全球历史前十的枪法，才是二阶71%？”
“枪法，得在实战中磨练，才能慢慢提升。不是那么容易的。反倒是《天蟒进化法》我才练了一次而已，还有很大提升空间。”许景明又开始练了起来。
一遍又一遍练习天蟒进化法，游戏引领者青衫男子，默默待在一旁。
练了许久。
“黎渺渺正在邀请你。”忽然收到提示。
许景明也停了下来，他也练得有些累了，轻轻一点，答应了邀请。
许景明便出现在沙滩上，前方就有一处美轮美奂的建筑，黎渺渺赤脚走在沙滩上，笑道：“景明，怎么样，这座小岛都是我的。”
“花了多少钱？”许景明笑着问道。
“十万块。”黎渺渺道，“特地选的一个小的海岛，否则还要更贵。”
“进入游戏也六个小时了，游戏都差不多摸清了吧，看过直播了么？”黎渺渺问道。
“还没去。”许景明道，他一直在认真练习天蟒进化法，作为职业武道选手，平常练桩功，练各种招数，一练几个小时也很正常，天蟒进化法可比任何桩功都要厉害得多，是根本性的改变筋骨肌肉，生命层次都发生变化，寿命都能翻倍的，他自然狂热专注。
“直播可一定要看。”黎渺渺带着许景明，点开观战平台。
观战平台，有大量的直播场景。
“直播太火热了。”黎渺渺说道，随即点开一个。
一名老者坐在那侃侃而谈。

下面却有无数座位，此刻已有数百人在听了，许景明和黎渺渺也凭空出现，坐在两个位置上。哗，也有观众消散离去。来来去去，是很正常的。
老者坐在上面说着：“每一次变革性科技面前，人类社会都会发生改变，这也是很多人改变命运的时候。而这一次，虚拟世界游戏的诞生，改变将比过去更彻底。就比如直播……过去的直播，是看视频。现在却是我在上面讲，大家在下面听。我们甚至可以一对一近距离互动。”
“练武场，可任意设置场景。所以场景可以设置成书房、舞台、演唱会大厅。”
“这将彻底改变直播市场，也改变教育市场，这是无比广阔的产业。”老者说着。
“走了。”
黎渺渺带着许景明，凭空消失，也有其他玩家进入这个直播间。
另一个直播间。
许景明、黎渺渺凭空出现，他们坐在虚空座位中，此刻有数百名玩家在观战，他们前方是一片雪地。
雪地中，有十人正在用冷兵器生死搏杀。
“我们在雪地战场外观战，可自带倍镜，放大远处的战斗场景。”黎渺渺说道，许景明试着一点，其中一处战斗场景迅速放大。
拉到最近距离，就仿佛在三米之外，观看别人的搏杀。
“铛。”一名女子左手一盾挡住对方的一斧，右手一剑咻的刺入敌人喉咙，敌人也化作虚影消散，退出了地图。
“真是刺激。”许景明看得惊叹。
世界武道大赛，哪有这么真实刺激？
“这才是真正的直播。”黎渺渺感慨，“听歌，就是坐在下面听台上的歌手唱歌。上课，就是坐在座位上听老师讲课。看战斗，就是身临其境，近距离观看。”
————
ps：听说现在新书也可以投月票了？番茄写小说十多年，还是第一次经历，大家能给点薄面，月票支持下么？
content_en:
Chapter 14 Real cold weapon battle
"You can slowly explore the functions of the training ground." The man in green shirt said, "Next, I want to tell you the battle space of the entire game world."
Xu Jingming nodded.
The world of life evolution is mainly divided into three major parts: personal space, mission space, and battle space.
"Wow."
The man in green shirt waved his hand.
A screen appeared in front of him, with five figures choosing weapons and armor.
"The battle space is where five people choose weapons and armor...then enter the map and engage in a life-and-death fight with five enemies. When one party is dead, the other party wins."
The man in green shirt said and waved his hand again, and the scene turned into an ancient town.
Small town, drizzle.
There were ten people in total, scattered throughout the town.
"Phew."
An arrow broke through the air in the rain and hit the enemy. The enemy hiding on the roof noticed something was wrong. When he turned around to look, the arrow was so fast that the enemy had no time to react. Poof! An arrow shot through the enemy's head. The moment it penetrated, the enemy turned into a phantom and dissipated, exiting the map.
"Kill!" A tough man rushed out, heading straight for the archer who fired the hidden arrow, and at the same time threw out the short spear in his hand.
Short spears were thrown out one after another! On his back was a short spear carrying two rucksacks.
The archer was so frightened that he ran away and fired back arrows. It was obvious that he was in panic and shot at a moving target. He was not accurate at all and did not hit the opponent.
"Pfft." Halfway through the escape, a short spear penetrated his chest, the leather armor on his body was penetrated, and the archer turned into a shadow and disappeared.
"Everyone can only attack from a distance. It's really boring." A tall and strong man with a height of two meters, wearing thick armor, with only his head exposed, was sitting in the middle of the town, holding a wine jar and drinking wine. His voice resounded throughout the town, "If you are brave, come and have a one-on-one with Grandpa."
"You silly bear, I'm here to meet you for a while." A female swordsman wearing red light armor strode out.
The cold weapon fighting scene in front of him, arrows, short spears, large axes, long spears, sharp swords... made Xu Jingming's blood boil. The most dangerous fighting mode of the martial arts weapon fighting he had pursued for the past twenty years was the scene in front of him!
"Real martial arts weapon fighting has various safety measures, how can it be so fun?" Xu Jingming was excited to see this, this is the best stage for him.
"The battle space is for five teammates and five other opponents to fight with cold weapons." The man in green shirt said, "You can choose thick armor, but your movement skills will be greatly affected. If you choose light soft armor, the defense will be weak. Everyone has their own choices."
"Distant attack, close combat, ambush..." The man in blue shirt smiled, "Because the battle level was relatively weak at the beginning of the game. The battle in front of me was a pretty good battle that was just live broadcast, but there are still many problems. Five people are fighting five people, and the more important thing is teamwork."
"Of course, if you are strong enough and can kill five people by one person, then you are the best." The man in green shirt smiled, "But high-level fighting requires a group of top masters in the entire Blue Star. Cold weapon combat skills, combat strategies, and teammate cooperation are all very important."
Xu Jingming nodded: "Five people versus five people? No one-on-one?"
"Not yet."
The man in green shirt said, "The core game mode of this virtual game is to form a team of five and fight with cold weapons."
Xu Jing understood clearly, but his eyes were burning.
Isn't this kind of cold weapon fighting scene what every professional martial arts player dreams of most? And the best thing is that when fighting in the game, dying is just a game failure.
"Each player is divided into levels according to their strength." The man in blue shirt said, "The weakest is the Fanxing level, the one step higher is the Silver Moon level, and the higher one is the Sun level! The highest is the God level."
"Fanxing players are novice players."
"Silver Moon level player, basicThe combat power threshold is 150. "
"The basic combat power threshold for a Yaori-level player is 400. "
“For god-level players, the basic combat power threshold is 1,000. "
“There are two ways to improve your level. One is to upgrade if the previous level reaches full stars and reaches the basic combat power threshold. The other is to reach 120% of the basic combat power threshold, and you can directly participate in the placement competition. After passing the placement competition... you can directly reach the new level. "
"For example, a novice player with a basic combat power of 480 can participate in the Yaori-level qualifying competition for the first time. Once he passes, he will directly become a Yaori-level player. There is no need to work your way up from the stars. "The man in green shirt explained.
Xu Jingming nodded slightly and looked at his personal combat power panel.
Player: Xu Jingming
Gene Evolution Method: "Sky Python Evolution Method" (Basic Level 5%) (Practice time 982 days, cannot be upgraded)
Skills: Marksmanship (71% at the second level), Footwork (11% at the second level)
Basic combat power:
“My marksmanship and footwork? "Xu Jingming was a little surprised.
"Before, when you were practicing marksmanship in the martial arts training ground, the virtual game automatically identified your marksmanship and footwork levels. "The man in green shirt explained.
"Basic combat strength is 756, how is it calculated? "Xu Jingming asked.
“The stronger the body, the higher the body mass index. Skills are various combat techniques. A strong body, coupled with powerful combat skills, determines the basic combat power. "The man in green shirt explained.
Xu Jingming nodded slightly and looked at the marksmanship on the panel. The marksmanship was his most confident: "The top ten marksmanship in global history is the second level 71%? "
“Marksmanship must be honed in actual combat to slowly improve. It's not that easy. On the contrary, I have only practiced the "Sky Python Evolution Method" once, and there is still a lot of room for improvement. "Xu Jingming started practicing again.
Practicing the Sky Python Evolution Method over and over again, the man in green shirt, the leader of the game, stayed silently aside.
Practiced for a long time.
"Li Miaomiao is inviting you. "Suddenly received a prompt.
Xu Jingming also stopped. He was also a little tired from practicing. He gently agreed to the invitation.
Xu Jingming appeared on the beach, with a beautiful building in front of him. Li Miaomiao walked barefoot on the beach and said with a smile: "Jingming, what do you think? This island belongs to me. "
"How much did it cost? "Xu Jingming asked with a smile.
“One hundred thousand dollars. "Li Miaomiao said, "A small island was specially chosen, otherwise it would be more expensive. "
"It has been six hours since I entered the game. I have almost figured out the game. Have you watched the live broadcast? Li Miaomiao asked.
“I haven’t gone yet. "Xu Jingming said, he has been practicing the Heavenly Python Evolution Method seriously. As a professional martial arts player, it is normal to practice pile skills and various moves for several hours at a time. The Heavenly Python Evolution Method is much more powerful than any pile skills. It fundamentally changes the muscles, muscles, life levels, and doubles the life span. He is naturally enthusiastic and focused.
“You must watch the live broadcast. "Li Miaomiao took Xu Jingming and opened the viewing platform.
The viewing platform has a large number of live broadcast scenes.
“The live broadcast is so hot. Li Miaomiao said, then clicked on one.
An old man sat there and talked.
There were countless seats below, and hundreds of people were listening at this moment. Xu Jingming and Li Miaomiao also appeared out of thin air and sat in two seats. Wow, some viewers also dispersed and left. It's normal to come and go.
The old man sat on it and said: "Every time there is a revolutionary technology, human society will change, and this is also a time when many people change their destiny. But this time, with the birth of virtual world games, the changes will be more thorough than in the past. Just like live broadcasts... In the past, live broadcasts were about watching videos. Now, I am speaking at the top and everyone is listening at the bottom. We can even interact one on one up close. "
“The martial arts training ground can be set up in any scene. So the scene can be set as a study room, stage, concert hall. "
“This will completely change the live broadcast market and also the education market, which is an extremely broad industry. "The old man said.
"Gone. "
Li Miaomiao took Xu Jingming and disappeared out of thin air. Other players also entered the live broadcast room.
Another live broadcast room.
Xu Jingming and Li Miaomiao appeared out of thin air. They were sitting in empty seats. There were hundreds of players watching the game, and there was a snowy field in front of them.
In the snow, ten people were fighting to the death with cold weapons.
“We are watching the battle on the snowy battlefield, and we can bring our own magnifying glass to magnify the battle scene in the distance. Li Miaomiao said, Xu Jingming tried a little, and one of the battle scenes quickly zoomed in.
When you get as close as possible, it's like watching other people fight from three meters away.
"Clang. "A woman used a shield in her left hand to block the opponent's axe, and stabbed the enemy's throat with a sword in her right hand. The enemy also turned into a phantom and disappeared, exiting the map.
“It’s really exciting. "Xu Jingming was amazed when he saw it.
How could the World Martial Arts Competition be so real and exciting?
“This is real live streaming. "Li Miaomiao sighed, "Listening to music means sitting down and listening to the singers on the stage. In class, you sit in your seat and listen to the teacher's lecture. To watch a battle is to be there and see it up close. "
